methodologyNotes: Roster of 11 connected smoke/combo smoke+CO devices plus audio "listener" accessories, after adversarial re-verification. All checks were WebFetch against source pages (WebSearch was unavailable); several retailer/manufacturer pages (X-Sense, Amazon, Lowe's, Best Buy) block automated fetches, and the Google Store is geo-consent-gated, so a number of prices are set to null rather than guessed (a null beats a guess). One draft entry (X-Sense "SC06-WX") was REMOVED: its own cited review covers only the RF-interconnect SC06-W (sealed 10-yr battery, Link+ mesh, no Wi-Fi) and makes no mention of any Wi-Fi "SC06-WX" model, whose specs/price were extrapolated. sensor_life_yr is the manufacturer-stated sealed-battery/sensor rated life in years (null when only a warranty period, not a life rating, is stated; null for the audio-listener accessories, which have no smoke/CO sensor of their own). Confirmed live prices: X-Sense SC07-WX $44.99 (the-gadgeteer), Kidde P4010ACSCO-WF $89.97 (Consumer Reports), Ecolink FireFighter $39 (Home Controls); Nest Protect held at $119 (canonical, store page consent-gated). Discontinued First Alert/Onelink models and blocked X-Sense/Ring listings had unverifiable prices nulled. Kidde voice_location_alerts nulled (Kidde voice output not confirmed as location-announcing; that is a First Alert feature). All prices USD; generatedAt and every accessedAt = 2026-08-16.

products.name: Google Nest Protect (2nd Gen, Battery)
products.priceNote: Google Store MSRP (S3000BWES); $119 list price has held since the 2015 launch. Store spec page was consent-gated during verification, so price is the well-established canonical MSRP rather than a fresh fetch.
products.provenance: Confirmed via Google's official spec support page: split-spectrum smoke sensor, 10-year electrochemical CO sensor, 6x AA (Energizer Ultimate Lithium L91) battery power, and 802.15.4 (2.4GHz) wireless interconnect. Voice/location alerts and monthly automatic self-test are documented Nest Protect features (not spelled out on the fetched page). Store price page redirected to a Google consent wall during fetch; $119 retained as the long-stable, currently-sold MSRP.

products.name: Google Nest Protect (2nd Gen, Wired)
products.priceNote: Google Store MSRP (S3003LWES); same $119 list as the battery variant. Store spec page consent-gated during verification.
products.provenance: Same sensor platform as the battery model; runs on 120V AC with 3 AA backup batteries per Google's spec page (802.15.4 wireless interconnect, 10-year CO sensor). Price kept as canonical $119 (store page consent-gated).

products.name: First Alert Onelink Safe & Sound
products.priceNote: Discontinued by First Alert; manufacturer page shows no current price. Original launch MSRP was around $249 but could not be confirmed via an accessible live source, so price is null.
products.provenance: First Alert's own (now-discontinued) product page confirms photoelectric+electrochemical sensors, hardwired power with a 10-year sealed-lithium backup battery, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth interconnect, and 85dB voice alerts that announce location and hazard type; built-in Alexa, UL 217/2034. Note the product warranty is 3 years (the 10-year figure is the sealed backup-battery rating, retained for sensor_life_yr). Price nulled: page lists no price and no live retail price was verifiable.

products.name: X-Sense SC07-WX
products.priceNote: X-Sense 1-pack list price ($44.99), confirmed via hands-on review; frequently discounted to ~$33 on Amazon (~$33.11/1-pack).
products.provenance: Photoelectric smoke + electrochemical CO sensing, replaceable CR123A battery, 2.4GHz Wi-Fi app connectivity (no unit-to-unit interconnect), 10-year unit operating life, button self-test — all confirmed in the-gadgeteer hands-on review, which also confirms the $44.99 X-Sense list price. releaseDate nulled: review is dated Jan 2024 and the exact release year (draft said 2023) was not corroborated.

products.name: X-Sense XS01-WT
products.priceNote: Published US price could not be confirmed (x-sense.com blocked automated fetch; the review did not state a price). Set to null rather than guessed.
products.provenance: Smoke-only photoelectric alarm (no CO sensor) confirmed via hands-on review, CR123A battery (~1yr cell, ~10yr rated unit life), Wi-Fi via Tuya Smart app (up to 100 networked units through the app, not direct interconnect), Test/Mute self-check. releaseDate 2021 retained (review published Jul 2021, positioned as successor to XS01-WR). Price nulled — not stated in any accessible source.

products.name: Kidde Smart Smoke + CO Alarm with Indoor Air Quality Monitor (P4010ACSCOAQ-WF)
products.priceNote: Not listed on manufacturer page; major retailer pages blocked automated access. Price null.
products.provenance: Kidde's product page confirms this model (P4010ACSCOAQ-WF) exists: Wi-Fi smart smoke+CO alarm adding indoor air-quality monitoring, hardwired AC interconnect with existing Kidde alarms, app alerts, Smart Hush, remote self-test, 10-year limited warranty. Sensor type carried as photoelectric (line standard, confirmed for the sibling P4010ACSCO-WF). voice_location_alerts nulled: Kidde voice output is not confirmed as location-announcing (that is a First Alert feature) and was not stated on the page. Price left null.

products.name: First Alert SCO501CN-3ST
products.priceNote: Discontinued by First Alert; manufacturer page shows no price and the third-party (Amazon) price could not be independently confirmed. Null rather than guessed.
products.provenance: First Alert's own (now-discontinued) page confirms photoelectric+electrochemical dual sensor, two-AA battery power, wireless mesh interconnect (up to 18 units), and voice-with-location alerts; no app connectivity. 7-year limited warranty; sensor_life_yr null (replaceable AA, no sealed-life rating). Price nulled: page is discontinued with no price and the Amazon figure was not verifiable.

products.name: Ring Alarm Smoke & CO Listener
products.priceNote: Draft's $129 was rejected: implausibly high for a microphone listener accessory (peer Ecolink FireFighter is $39; this Ring accessory retailed far lower) and unverifiable. Original ring.com product URL now 404s. Price set to null.
products.provenance: Real, well-known Ring Alarm accessory — a microphone-based listener (3V lithium battery) that detects an existing UL-listed smoke or CO alarm's siren pattern and relays a phone alert via the Ring Alarm Base Station; it is not a smoke/CO sensor itself, hence sensor_type 'audio_listener', sensor_life_yr null, and self_test false. Corrections: the original ring.com/products/alarm-smoke-co-listener source returned HTTP 404 (dead) and was replaced with the Lowe's product listing (real, topical; Lowe's blocks automated fetches); the draft's $129 price was rejected and nulled; releaseDate nulled as no working source could confirm it.

products.name: Kidde P4010ACSCO-WF
products.priceNote: Consumer Reports listed price ($89.97), confirmed on their lab-tested product page.
products.provenance: Consumer Reports' lab-tested listing confirms $89.97, photoelectric sensor, and hardwired (120V AC) power. Kidde's product page confirms Wi-Fi app alerts, remote self-test, and hardwired interconnect with existing Kidde alarms; 10-year sealed-battery backup/alarm life. voice_location_alerts changed from true to null: neither Consumer Reports nor Kidde confirms location-announcing voice alerts.

products.name: First Alert PRC710
products.priceNote: Discontinued by First Alert (replaced by SMCO210); no current price listed. Null.
products.provenance: First Alert's own (discontinued) page confirms photoelectric+electrochemical combo sensor, built-in 10-year sealed lithium battery, slim design, single-button silence/test (self_test true), no interconnect, no app, and no voice alerts (distinguishing it from the PRC710V voice variant). 85dB siren, UL 217/2034. Basic app-free connected-adjacent device retained per the requested exact SKU; price null (discontinued).

products.name: Ecolink Z-Wave Plus FireFighter (FF-ZWAVE5-ECO)
products.priceNote: List price at Home Controls ($39.00), confirmed on the product page.
products.provenance: Home Controls' page confirms $39.00, a microphone-based Z-Wave Plus (Gen5/500-series, 908.42MHz) accessory with an included CR123A 3V lithium battery (~5-year life) that recognizes Temporal-3 smoke and 4-pattern CO alarm signals from an existing UL-listed alarm and relays them to a Z-Wave hub/app. No smoke/CO sensor of its own, hence sensor_type 'audio_listener' and sensor_life_yr null; self_test false (not described). All headline fields verified on the source page.
